title: Pinned questions: B5 safety gate and benefit gate (accuracy, freshness and lifecycle dollars per correct fresh answer)

baselines.note: run 3 control: the exact evidence pinned refresh retrieves (retrieveEvidence: entity page, then pages linking to or naming it, newest first, then hybrid hits, facts, timeline, takes) handed to the same reader at the pinned answer delivered-token budget (floor 200); no maintained answer. Sensitivity arms anchored_reader_full and query_reader_full get every item / top 16 hits.
hybrid query (keyword-only: no embedding key in the harness brain) at the pinned answer's delivered-token budget, then one reader call
on-demand think per read with the default deep model

models.selection: answer/refresh and think: gbrain's default for questions (models.standing_questions -> deep tier); reader: the B-suite fixed reader

sources.embeddings: voyage:voyage-4 after every batch; balanced search mode

sources.events: corrections appended as dated notes (old pages left as written); conflicting notes in batch 4; remember in batch 6, forget in batch 7; newest note made private in batch 10

safety_gate.required: zero stale-sentence or cross-grant leakage on every surface

run_3.note: includes a 0.38 one-entity smoke run and a 0.48 Sonnet refresh replay

decision_rule.run_3: Preregistered in the README (e17258eb) before any run-3 cell: default-on if pinned (default refresh model) beats the anchored control in every seed on accuracy or freshness lag with zero leaks; a tie means the anchored retrieval is the win and pinned goes back to opt-in; any leak means opt-in.
decision_rule.run_2: Set before run 2: if pinned beats query+reader on accuracy or freshness without leakage, ship default-on (plan C1); otherwise opt-in stands.
